reasons.action: The request only combines a body from one picture and wheels from another into a single subject; it does not ask the car to perform any new action or behavior, so the reference's static presentation governs action.
reasons.medium: The medium decision preserves the live-action rendering; the request specifies subject composition across references, not a rendering-medium change.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested; the observed carbon fibre body remains the reference-owned wardrobe attribute.
reasons.lighting: The request gives no instruction about light, its source, direction or visible quality, so the reference lighting governs.
reasons.framing: The request does not specify a camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or movement, so reference framing governs.
reasons.palette: The request does not specify color grading, saturation, contrast or tonal treatment, so the reference palette governs.
